request:
Edit the first input image, the selected storyboard. Preserve the existing four landscape panel positions in a 2×2 grid, exact original numbered SHOT_ badges, original palette/compositions and actor likeness. The second input is original family visual reference. Dan blue / left watch, Maya plum with ponytail, Nina teal auburn waves, Leo orange, braided Ella in denim overalls, small Max green. A third reference supplies setting or continuity. In every panel actors and props must follow its specified shot precisely. Keep good panels intact. Apply the following specific changes in the artwork. The third guide shows the actual checkout and exact receipt/price card. Hold fruit inventory continuous: the one grape bunch in the blue-handled wicker basket is DARK PURPLE in all four panels. Never switch it to green, blackberries or a second bunch. Render prices sharp and spelled exactly. Frame to make small props readable. 049 customer-facing register display reads '$15.50' with receipt marked the same. 050 Dan pays with ONE visibly marked green paper bill whose corner reads '20' or '$20'; Leo holds the small grocery budget card. Cashier is hands-only/offscreen. 051 countable change: precisely four separate pale green paper bills face up in one neat row, EACH simply labeled '$1', alongside precisely TWO silver coins each marked '25¢'. Printed receipt beside them. Dan/Max/Nina looking, with the full basket retaining purple grapes. 052 Leo's small budget card clearly distinguishes '$16.00 − $15.50 = $0.50' versus '$4.50 cash change'. Change goes into wallet, same purchased fruit in basket. Separate the two amounts on different lines; no extra currency or invented amount. Keep family design, wardrobe and actual four panel labels. Use a readable register and paperwork within the scene; no subtitles or floating signs.
SHOT_049 shows only DAN, LEO, MAYA in FRUIT_CHECKOUT. Dan sets the full basket on the checkout counter without unloading fruit into duplicate piles. He retrieves the card from his right pocket and hands it to Leo. A silent clerk’s hands present the nine-line receipt and the register’s $15.50 total, supplied through editorial overlays. Leo checks against the card. End: Checkout total confirmed $15.50; full basket on counter; receipt laid flat beside it; card with Leo. Existing artwork error: Leo holds receipt as Dan offers card; grapes have changed from purple at 048 to green. Fix: Retain original purple grapes and composite exact $15.50 receipt/display.
SHOT_050 shows only DAN, LEO in FRUIT_CHECKOUT. Dan takes his wallet from his right trouser pocket, removes one twenty-dollar bill and lays it flat toward the clerk. The clerk’s hand accepts it. Leo keeps his hands away from the payment and fruit. End: $20 payment accepted; wallet open in Dan’s hand; no change returned yet; card stays with Leo. Existing artwork error: One bill passes to silent clerk's hand; green grape punnet persists and denomination indistinct. Fix: Restore purple grapes and readable $20 bill detail.
SHOT_051 shows only DAN, MAX, NINA in FRUIT_CHECKOUT. The silent clerk’s hand lays four one-dollar bills and two quarters beside the receipt. Dan counts the four bills, then indicates the two quarters. Nina keeps Max beside her; he watches without grabbing money. End: Exactly $4.50 change on counter: four $1 bills and two $0.25 coins; receipt beside it. Existing artwork error: Four bills and two coins on counter; bill faces and receipt blank, grape tray green. Fix: Apply exact $1 and quarter values, correct receipt and purple grape continuity.
SHOT_052 shows only LEO, MAX, DAN in FRUIT_CHECKOUT. Leo lays the card beside the receipt and points to the printed budget line to explain the different starting amounts. Dan gathers the four bills and two quarters into his wallet after Max understands; Leo then hands him the card and receipt together. End: Change $4.50 stored in wallet; card and receipt still in Dan’s other hand; fruit unchanged. Existing artwork error: Leo points to blank two-color card by blank receipt, Dan has open wallet; green grapes remain. Fix: Show $0.50 budget remainder versus $4.50 cash change; keep purchased grapes purple.
